mapper.select: SELECT O.ORDER_ID AS orderId, O.USER_ID AS userId, O.TOTAL_PRICE AS price, OI.ITEM_ID AS itemId, OI.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, OI.OPTION_ITEM_ID AS optionItemId, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, OI.QUANTITY AS count, COALESCE(POI.ITEM_NAME, '기본 옵션') AS optionName, ( SELECT PI.IMG_URL FROM PRODUCT_IMG PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_ID = OI.PRODUCT_ID AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' ORDER BY PI.SORT_ORDER ASC, PI.IMAGE_ID ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS imgUrl, UA.ZIPCODE AS zipcode, UA.ADDRESS AS address, UA.DETAILED_ADDRESS AS detailedAddress FROM ORDERS O JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON O.ORDER_ID = OI.ORDER_ID INNER JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_OPTION_ITEM POI ON OI.OPTION_ITEM_ID = POI.OPTION_ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN USER_ADDRESS UA ON O.USER_ID = UA.USER_ID AND UA.ADDRESS_ID = ( SELECT UA2.ADDRESS_ID FROM USER_ADDRESS UA2 WHERE UA2.USER_ID = O.USER_ID ORDER BY UA2.DEFAULT_YN DESC, UA2.ADDRESS_ID ASC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE O.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND O.USER_ID = #{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ORDER_EXCHANGE ( ORDER_ID, USER_ID, EXCHANGE_REASON, REASON_DETAIL, EXCHANGE_METHOD, ZIPCODE, ADDRESS, DETAILED_ADDRESS, MEMO, NEW_OPTION_ITEM_ID, SHIPPING_FEE, IS_SELLER_FAULT, EXCHANGE_STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{exchangeReason}, #{reasonDetail}, #{exchangeMethod}, #{zipcode}, #{address}, #{detailedAddress}, #{memo}, #{newOptionItemId}, #{shippingFee}, #{isSellerFault}, 'REQUESTED', NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT poi.OPTION_ITEM_ID AS optionItemId, poi.ITEM_NAME AS itemName, poi.EXTRA_PRICE AS extraPrice, COALESCE( (SELECT SUM(ps.AVAILABLE_QTY) FROM product_stock ps WHERE ps.OPTION_ITEM_ID = poi.OPTION_ITEM_ID), 0 ) AS availableQty FROM product_option_item poi WHERE poi.PRODUCT_ID = ( SELECT oi.PRODUCT_ID FROM order_item oi WHERE oi.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY poi.OPTION_ITEM_ID
